query: What are the hiring guidelines for recruiting Penn State engineering students?

Penn State may flag discriminatory selection practices and help employers reach a broader student audience [1]. Employers can review these guidelines on the "Hiring Best Practices & Recruiting Guidelines" page [1].

IPAC advises the College of Engineering on academic issues and current trends in engineering [1][3]. It serves as a forum for exchanging ideas and recommendations to improve educational and research programs [1]. Penn State's IP policies aim to remove impediments to enable a free exchange of ideas and provide flexibility for faculty and students working with industry sponsors [3].

The College uses the ideas generated and the recommendations made during these forums to identify actions the College should take to continuously improve our educational and research programs and to take on global engineering grand challenges.
